fix.item: Fixed dynamic embed observer delay for directly inserted script and iframe nodes by inspecting them synchronously instead of waiting for the debounced subtree scan
Fixed dashboard package version loading by replacing suppressed simplexml_load_file usage with PackageVersionHelper
Fixed consent registry availability probe to avoid COUNT(*) on every write path

change.item: Dynamic observer now uses immediate inspection for direct SCRIPT and IFRAME nodes and keeps the 150 ms debounced scan only for container subtrees
Server-side HTML blocking now skips template and SVG segments through HtmlBlockingGuard before regex transforms
Removed alpha-era Google service *_mode parameter reads from GoogleServicesHelper
Added CSP nonce runtime verification checklist in qa/csp-verification.md
Added consent observer scheduling regression tests for Node test runner

note.item: Recommended stable release for production Joomla 6 sites
Install or update using the full pkg_devartconsent package only
Dynamic embed blocking remains best-effort; use window.DevArtConsent.whenGranted() for custom widgets
CDN or reverse-proxy cache purge remains manual after policy version increases
Validated on Joomla 6 with cache-first frontend behaviour and demo3 production-like QA

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Consent package with component and system plugin architecture
Added cache-first consent banner with accept, reject, custom preferences and revoke
Added server-side blocking for Google services, marketing pixels, external embeds and custom rules
Added scoped throttled MutationObserver for dynamically inserted script and iframe nodes
Added Google Consent Mode v2 integration with early default denied state
Added optional consent registry with CSV export and com_ajax recording endpoint
Added built-in English and Greek frontend messages
Added DevArt appearance themes, radius presets and floating privacy button icons
Added administrator dashboard status panel with blocking-layer summary
Added per-service Google blocking for Analytics, GTM, Ads, AdSense and Ad Manager
Added marketing pixel blocking for Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn
Added independently configurable external embed providers including YouTube, Vimeo, Google Maps and social widgets
Added custom blocking rules with up to 30 administrator-defined patterns
Added CSP nonce support for inline bootstrap scripts and appearance CSS through CspNonceHelper
Added automatic Joomla page cache clear when policy version increases through SiteCacheHelper
Added public frontend API window.DevArtConsent with isGranted, whenGranted and capabilities flags
Added runtime verification corpus, automated helper tests and production QA checklists
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support

change.item: Consent architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6, PHP 8.3+ and full-page cache compatibility
Frontend renders the same HTML for all visitors; consent is applied client-side without Vary Cookie
Blocked third-party markup is restored in the browser only after the relevant category is granted
Blocking pipeline uses cheap pre-checks, per-layer skip logic and per-request runtime config cache
Privacy and cookie policy URLs accept only http(s) or site-relative paths with subdirectory-safe resolution
Non-HTML, JSON, XML and feed responses are excluded from banner injection through RenderedBodyGuard
Live third-party scripts are tracked with an in-memory WeakMap instead of data attributes on activated tags

security.item: Added PolicyUrlHelper sanitization rejecting javascript, data and parent-directory traversal in policy URLs
Added RenderedBodyGuard to prevent consent rewrites on non-HTML API and feed responses
Added CSRF protection for administrator settings and consent registry actions
Added ACL enforcement for administrator component access
Added malformed and expired consent cookie invalidation on the client
Added controller to service to storage flow for consent registry without exposing filesystem paths

note.item: Initial public DevArt Consent stable release for Joomla 6
Install using the full pkg_devartconsent package, not the component ZIP alone
Dynamic embed blocking cannot guarantee zero network activity before observer callback for src-based nodes
Purge CDN or reverse-proxy cache manually after policy version changes
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment
